scope: Proposition 7.4 of the manuscript “Tame Hecke Eigensheaves with Several Marked Points” (preprints/Tame-Hecke-Eigensheaves-with-Several-Marked-Points-October-5-2026/Tame-Hecke-Eigensheaves-with-Several-Marked-Points.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 014 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 fb3f3a7a4115f5ec), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 35-36. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let X/C be a smooth projective connected curve of genus at least two, with s ≥ 2 distinct marked points, divisor D their sum, and G = SLn. Let σ be a continuous dense Ǧ-parameter on their complement, defined over a finite coefficient extension, with unipotent monodromy at every 35 marking. Then BunG,B,D(X) carries a nonzero locally constructible perverse geometric E-adic eigensheaf with eigenvalue σ, nilpotent singular support, and the full coherent Hecke system in relative Satake normalization.
